scope: All 230 existing country entries (227 sites), plus the requested LSB Bremen article. Overlay research only.
method: Certificate-validating HTTP requests to each listed URL, up to 18 seconds per page; inspect script elements for provider-specific domains or paths. Three same-site loader scripts inspected as follow-up. No browser JavaScript execution, consent changes or widget interaction. Script references are evidence of integration, not proof of successful runtime execution.
limits: No matching script or failed access is inconclusive and does not prove overlay removal. Provider engine matches do not establish the reseller. Existing provider labels are retained. This is not a compliance assessment.
previously_unchecked_snapshot: Local combined-list.json from 2026-10-07; matches 163 present entries by hostname, including the consolidated Hudikhem entry.

lsb_bremen_article.finding: The article states that LSB Bremen uses Eye-Able. Current HTML also loads its site configuration and eyeAble.js. Security-incident claims are not added to the overlay page.
